description:
WHO WE ARE

GridUnity is the industry leader in interconnection life cycle management, delivering cutting-edge software solutions that eliminate bottlenecks in the interconnection process and accelerate the transition to a more affordable, sustainable, and resilient energy future.

Our Mission

We unite all grid interconnection stakeholders on a single platform that converts centralized data into actionable intelligence and accelerates the transition to a reliable, sustainable, and cost-efficient electric grid.

GridUnity is a trusted partner to leading utilities, grid operators, and policymakers. Our technology solutions tackle the interconnection queue backlog by significantly reducing processing times. Whether cutting transmission interconnection timelines from years to months or enabling distribution applications to be processed within a day, we help accelerate energy projects at every scale.

Our Vision
Energizing the planet with a faster, smarter, and more sustainable grid.

About the DIGITAL Project

DIGITAL (Digital Integration for Grid Interconnection Tools, Analysis, and Logic) is a $90M project funded by a Department of Energy (DOE) grant and GridUnity cost share under the DOE’s Grid Resilience and Innovation Partnerships (GRIP) Program. The project's objective is to accelerate the interconnection of energy resources to the U.S. electric grid by shortening the complete interconnection lifecycle.

About the Role

Reporting to the VP of Operations, the Program Manager owns the administration and execution of the DIGITAL project end to end. This role will drive successful delivery by hitting project milestones, managing the $90M project budget, surfacing risk early and actioning mitigations, and submitting DOE deliverables.

This is a heavy execution role that also requires coordination across all GridUnity departments. The DIGITAL project plan is fulfilled by GridUnity's Product, Engineering, Customer Experience, and FinOps teams, so you will work across every part of the company to keep the project plan synchronized with the product roadmap and actual customer delivery. You will be the connective tissue between the goals of the DIGITAL project, what GridUnity develops and deploys, and what we report and invoice to the DOE. You should be equally comfortable running a milestone review with product and engineering leads, walking a DOE project officer through a quarterly report, and defending the project's spend plan line by line.

Responsibilities

Project plan and execution

  • Own the Project Management Plan (PMP) and drive execution of the project plan across all tasks: schedule, milestone log, deliverables log, metrics, and risk register.

  • Run the project's operating cadence: Milestone reviews, cross-functional status, and executive updates so that progress is visible and decisions get made on time.

  • Coordinate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience to ensure the PMP accurately reflects the progress of the product roadmap and customer deployment, and manage formal updates to the plan when actual delivery and the baseline plan diverge.

Budget management

  • Manage the project to its approved budget: track actuals against the spend plan by task and budget category, across both federal share and GridUnity cost share.

  • Identify budget under- and over-utilization early, work with finance and functional leads on corrective action, and manage re-budgeting when needed.

Risk management

  • Own the project risk register: identify emerging gaps between planned milestones and current trajectory, surface them with options rather than surprises, and drive mitigation to closure.

  • Monitor dependencies across workstreams and escalate conflicts between project commitments and other company priorities.

DOE reporting, invoicing, and compliance

  • Prepare and submit DOE reporting deliverables including quarterly progress reports and annual go/no-go review materials

  • Own preparation of invoices to DOE, ensuring costs are allowable, allocable, and supported by documentation that will stand up to audit.

  • Demonstrate the value of actualized spend in advancing the project's goals: connect dollars spent to milestones achieved, software released, and deployments completed in every report and review.

  • Serve as day-to-day point of contact with the DOE project officer and grants management specialist, and coordinate GridUnity's responses to DOE requests.

Qualifications

  • Director-level program or project management experience (10+ years), with a record of owning large, multi-year programs end to end: plan, budget, risks, and reporting.

  • Experience with Department of Energy awards, as a recipient, contractor, or DOE staff, including federal reporting, invoicing, and the mechanics of managing the award

  • Background in the electric grid and utility sector; familiarity with interconnection strongly preferred.

  • Experience managing programs built on SaaS product delivery. Comfortable working with product and engineering teams on roadmaps, release cycles, and agile development.

  • Strong cross-functional operator: able to drive outcomes through teams that don't report to you, from engineering leads to finance to executives.

  • Excellent written communication; able to produce federal-grade reports and briefings independently

  • Project Management Professional certification or equivalent is a plus. U.S. work authorization requi

OUR CULTURE

We are a lean, fast-moving team that values bold thinking, reliability, and continuous learning. We operate with radical transparency, embrace scrappiness, and build solutions that anticipate customer needs. We also believe work should be fun and fulfilling — what we call “funfillment.”

The right candidate is energized by working in a scaling, mission-driven company where they can shape processes, wear multiple hats, and grow alongside the business.

BENEFITS/PERKS

  • Competitive compensation packages that recognize your expertise and contributions

  • Remote-first culture that provides flexibility and balance

  • Professional development opportunities, including training, mentorship, and career pathing

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance starting day one

  • Short- and long-term disability and basic life insurance at no cost to you

  • 401(k) plan with a 4% match to help secure your future

  • Flexible PTO and a supportive work culture that values balance

  • Mission-driven work with the opportunity to make a significant impact in the energy sector

ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENT

This position may involve access to data and systems subject to U.S. critical infrastructure protection regulations. Accordingly, this role is restricted to individuals who qualify as “U.S. persons,” defined by federal law as U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents (green card holders), asylees, or refugees.

OUR COMMITMENT TO APPLICANTS

GridUnity is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, arrest and conviction record, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued, supported, and able to bring their authentic self to work.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please email careers@gridunity.com.

For your security, all official communication from GridUnity will only come from email addresses ending in @gridunity.com.
